For finite free-even \(H^*(B;\mathbb Z)\), the \(MU\) Atiyah–Hirzebruch spectral sequence collapses in even filtration with torsion-free groups, so rationalization is injective. Rational Chern–Dold transforms of the two universal first Chern classes are respectively divisible by ordinary \(u,v\), giving \(UV=0\) in \(MU\), hence every oriented \(E\). Formal-group identity \(F(x,U)F(x,V)-xF(x,F(U,V))\in(UV)\) makes the rank-two projective bundle relations coincide. The two determinants agree, so the relative tangent line and total tangent \(E\)-Chern classes agree. In \(K^0\), \((l-1)(m-1)=0\) yields identical special \(\lambda\)-ring presentations generated by the base and the tautological line class. The nonhomotopy conclusion is explicitly attributed to Gong–Li, not independently proved here.
